C24 is a weaker parallel using similar presidential-function delegation language, but it concerns a different official and lacks the Budget Director-specific administrative structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"delegating the director the bureau the budget the authority the","parent_excerpt":"The Director of the Bureau of the Budget is hereby authorized and empowered to exercise the authority vested in the President","explanation":"This is a distinctive match in the delegated official, the legal act of delegation, and the presidential authority being transferred."},{"child_excerpt":"delegating the director the bureau the budget the authority the","parent_excerpt":"The Director of the Bureau of the Budget shall from time to time report to the President ... and shall ... exercise such direction and control","explanation":"C06 provides concrete follow-on administrative machinery accompanying the delegation, making it more than a generic shared governmental function."}]}
